description: Apply the owner’s edit prompt to reviewed photos. Quote first with soclo_image_photo_edit_quote. SPENDS the quoted credits only after the owner approves the price. Pass expectedCredits, pricingVersion and ownerApprovedPrice:true from the approved quote, including zero only when the account quote permits it. Use the selected private photo locators from soclo_photo_reference_prepare or soclo_brand_photo_reference in their original order. Image-edit permission is one tap once per account; people in photos are allowed. The result is saved to the owner’s Soclo Library and returned as libraryAssetId and resultUrl. Save a UUID clientRequestId before calling. A pending result reattaches with the identical inputs and same request ID; an exact replay returns the original picture without a second charge. After a lost result or unknown charge, use soclo_image_recover with the original clientRequestId; never start a replacement purchase. This tool does not publish.

clientRequestId.description: Required before generate: one stable UUID per picture purchase. Required before frames; recover and frames_result read the original UUID without a new render. Never retry an unknown outcome automatically or mint a replacement ID to bypass a duplicate refusal.

expectedCredits.description: Required: use the exact authenticated native quote, including zero only when quoted for the owner-exempt account. Frames uses its own existing quote.

gptRefusalRequestId.description: Required for nano_banana_pro: the earlier GPT edit request that refused. Never use backup for a new text-only picture or an unknown charge.

imageUrls.description: Selected reviewed private photo locators in their original order.

model.description: Default photo_edit uses the native photo edit quote. GPT Image (dalle) and Nano Banana Pro are photo editors too; Nano Banana Pro is only an approved backup after a GPT edit refusal.

ownerApprovedPrice.description: Required true for generate only after the account owner has seen the tier price and approved this single picture purchase. A retry spend needs a new yes.

pictureTier.description: For generate: premium is the default; use standard only if the owner chooses it. Read the authenticated native quote for the exact account price.

pricingVersion.description: From the authenticated native quote for this picture or enhancement; frames uses its own quote.

prompt.description: Required for generate: the host-authored scene text, sent directly to image generation.

name: soclo_image_photo_edit
title: Edit a photo
